changePassword.descriptionMustChange: You must set a new password before continuing.
changePassword.temporaryPasswordNotice: A temporary password was set for your account. Please change it now.

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.subtitle: API keys let you authenticate API requests without using your session cookies. Treat them like passwords — never share them.
apiKeys.empty: No API keys yet. Create one to get started.

yourKeys.title: Your keys
yourKeys.description: Keys are shown with only the first 8 characters for identification.

createDialog.title: Create API key
createDialog.description: Give your key a descriptive name so you can identify it later.

revealDialog.title: API key created
revealDialog.description: Copy your new key now. You won't be able to see it again.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke API key
revokeDialog.confirmPrefix: Are you sure you want to revoke
revokeDialog.confirmSuffix: ? Any requests using this key will stop working immediately.

errors.nameTooLong: Name must be 100 characters or fewer.
errors.createFailed: Failed to create key. Please try again.
errors.copyFailed: Copy failed. Please copy the key manually.

preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.subtitle: Choose how you want to be notified.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Protect your account and control how you sign in.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: Ask for a code from an authenticator app, in addition to your password, when you sign in.
mfa.recoveryLow: You are running low on recovery codes. Generate new ones before you lose access.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalidCode: That code is invalid or was already used.
errors.unavailable: Two-step verification isn't available: the server has no encryption key configured. Ask your administrator.
errors.load: Couldn't load your two-step verification status.

setup.title: Set up two-step verification
setup.description: Use an authenticator app such as 1Password, Google Authenticator or Authy.
setup.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
setup.orEnterKey: Can't scan? Enter this key instead.
setup.qrLabel: QR code for two-step verification setup
setup.codeLabel: Enter the 6-digit code from the app
setup.codesDescription: Each code works once if you lose access to your authenticator app.
setup.codesWarning: These codes are shown only now. Store them somewhere safe before closing.

disable.title: Turn off two-step verification
disable.description: Your account will be protected by your password alone. Enter a current code to confirm.

regenerate.title: Generate new recovery codes
regenerate.description: This replaces all your existing recovery codes. Enter a current code to confirm.
